北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天晴朗，体感 7℃ 较凉，记得添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is clear, feels cool at 7℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 11℃ 微凉，注意保暖，出门带伞哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast, feels slightly cool at 11℃. Stay warm and take an umbrella!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 12℃ 微凉。出行注意防雨，别着凉哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels slightly cool at 12℃. Stay warm and mind the rain!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天潮湿，体感 22℃ 舒适。出门记得带伞哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is humid and overcast, feels comfy at 22℃. Don't forget your umbrella!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 22℃ 温和。注意湿度，出门带伞哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast, feels mild at 22℃. Mind the humidity and bring an umbrella!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 11℃ 稍凉。风力 2级，添件外套吧！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast, feels cool at 11℃ with a 2-level breeze. Grab a jacket!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 10℃ 偏凉。风力 3级，注意防风保暖！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is clear, feels cool at 10℃ with a 3-level wind. Stay warm and block the wind!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 17℃ 宜人。空气不错，出门走走吧！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels pleasant at 17℃. Air is good, enjoy a walk!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，体感 12℃ 凉意。外出记得戴口罩，注意防护。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze, feels cool at 12℃. Wear a mask if heading out, stay safe!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 10℃ 较凉，湿度低。记得多喝水！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels cool at 10℃, very dry. Remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 17℃ 舒适。湿度高，出门记得带伞！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels comfy at 17℃. High humidity, bring an umbrella!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 4℃ 寒冷。风力 3级，务必多穿保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is clear, feels cold at 4℃ with a 3-level wind. Please dress very warmly!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 7℃ 凉意。风力 3级，注意防风保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear, feels cool at 7℃ with a 3-level wind. Stay warm and block the wind!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 15℃ 舒适，但风力 3级。注意温差！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels comfortable at 15℃ with a 3-level wind. Mind the temperature difference!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 16℃ 宜人。风力 3级，出门注意防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast, feels pleasant at 16℃ with a 3-level wind. Mind the wind when out!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，体感 4℃ 寒冷。风力 3级，出行注意安全！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy, feels cold at 4℃ with a 3-level wind. Travel safely!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 4℃ 寒冷。风力 3级，记得多穿衣！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels cold at 4℃ with a 3-level wind. Remember to bundle up!
